# tidybrreg

Tidy R interface to Norway’s [Central Coordinating Register for Legal
Entities](https://www.brreg.no/en/) (Enhetsregisteret), maintained by
the Brønnøysund Register Centre. The register contains approximately 1
million active entities. Data is published under the [Norwegian Licence
for Open Government Data (NLOD 2.0)](https://data.norge.no/nlod/en/2.0).

This repository holds three packages that are versioned and built
together:

| Package | Directory | Purpose |
|----|----|----|
| **tidybrreg** | `/` | The typed client: sixteen functions, one per register endpoint. CRAN-bound. |
| **tidybrregpanel** | `tidybrregpanel/` | Managed state: Parquet snapshots, `brreg_sync()`, replay, changelog, flows, panels, series, networks, survival data. |
| **tidybrregmcp** | `tidybrregmcp/` | A Model Context Protocol server whose tools, schemas and documentation are derived from tidybrreg’s exports and help pages. |
| **tidybrreg-mcp** | `tidybrreg-mcp-node/` | The same server without R: an npm package (`npx tidybrreg-mcp`) built from the manifest tidybrregmcp writes, for Claude, ChatGPT and OpenAI clients. |

## Installation

``` r

install.packages(c("tidybrreg", "tidybrregpanel", "tidybrregmcp"),
  repos = c("https://sondreskarsten.r-universe.dev",
            "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# Or from GitHub
pak::pak("sondreskarsten/tidybrreg")
pak::pak("sondreskarsten/tidybrreg/tidybrregpanel")
pak::pak("sondreskarsten/tidybrreg/tidybrregmcp")
```

## Entity lookup

``` r

library(tidybrreg)

brreg_entity("923609016")
#> # A tibble: 1 x 63
#>   org_nr    name        legal_form founding_date employees nace_1
#>   <chr>     <chr>       <chr>      <date>            <int> <chr>
#> 1 923609016 EQUINOR ASA ASA        1972-09-18        21408 06.100

# Sub-entities (establishments)
brreg_entity("974760843", registry = "underenheter")
```

Only observed fields are emitted; `registry` and `deleted` are always
present. Codes by default. Translate with `type = "label"` or
[`brreg_label()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_label.md):

``` r

brreg_entity("923609016", type = "label")

brreg_entity("923609016") |>
  brreg_label(code = c("legal_form", "nace_1"))

brreg_label(c("AS", "ENK"), dic = "legal_form", lang = "no")
```

## Search

``` r

brreg_search(legal_form = "AS", municipality_code = "0301",
             min_employees = 500, max_results = 10)

# Sub-entity search
brreg_search(name = "Equinor", registry = "underenheter", max_results = 5)
```

A query that matches more than the register’s 10,000-result window
aborts with `tidybrreg_error_result_window` rather than returning a
partial population; results carry `total_matches` and `complete`
attributes.

## Roles, groups and signing authority

``` r

brreg_roles("923609016")          # who holds roles IN an entity
brreg_roles_legal("923609016")    # roles an entity holds in OTHER entities
brreg_konsern("923609016")        # the corporate group tree
brreg_signatur("923609016")       # who may sign for the entity
brreg_prokura("923609016")        # procuration holders
```

## Annual accounts

``` r

acc <- brreg_regnskap("923609016")                    # one row per filing, up to 3 years per type
acc[c("account_type", "period_end", "currency", "consistent")]
tidyr::unnest(acc, items)                             # statement, group, item, path, level, is_sum, value
brreg_regnskap("923609016", account_type = "SELSKAP", year = 2025)
```

The figures are nested per filing and keep the API’s structure, so a
group’s total and its components are never summed together by accident;
`consistent` and `inconsistencies` flag filings whose accounting
identities do not hold (the register publishes them as filed). Banks,
insurers and pension funds answer with a plan the API does not serve;
the result is the typed empty with `unsupported_plan` and a
`tidybrreg_warning_unsupported_plan`.

## Incremental updates

``` r

brreg_updates(since = "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z", size = 1000, max_pages = 10)
brreg_update_fields(since = Sys.Date() - 1)
brreg_updates(type = "roller", since = Sys.Date() - 1)
```

## Bulk downloads

``` r

entities     <- brreg_download(type = "enheter")       # ~196 MB JSON
sub_entities <- brreg_download(type = "underenheter")  # ~75 MB JSON
roles        <- brreg_download(type = "roller")        # ~131 MB JSON
path         <- brreg_download(type_output = "path")
```

## Validate organization numbers

``` r

library(tidybrreg)
brreg_validate(c("923609016", "984851006", "123456789"))
#> [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE
```

## Design

**Codes by default, labels on demand.** Functions return Norwegian
codes.
[`brreg_label()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_label.md)
translates to English or Norwegian via bundled reference data or live
SSB KLASS lookups; `options(tidybrreg.offline = TRUE)` stays on the
bundled dictionaries.

**Observed fields only.** A column is present when the register emitted
the field; nothing is fabricated as `NA`. Unknown API fields pass
through with auto-generated snake_case names (zero-drop policy).

**Typed conditions.** Every error and warning has a class and fields
([`?tidybrreg_conditions`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/tidybrreg_conditions.md)):
deleted entities, partial or truncated results, result-window overflow,
unknown feed members, bundled-dictionary fallback.

**One coercion rule.** Dictionary types are identical on the live JSON
path and the bulk JSON path; parse failures are reported, never fatal.

**UTC instants.** Feed timestamps and HTTP dates are UTC `POSIXct`
whatever the session time zone.

## Functions

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`brreg_entity()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_entity.md) | Single entity by organization number (enheter or underenheter) |
| [`brreg_search()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_search.md) | Filtered search (enheter or underenheter) |
| [`brreg_underenheter()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_underenheter.md) | Sub-units of an entity |
| [`brreg_children()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_children.md) | Children in the ORGL administrative hierarchy |
| [`brreg_roles()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_roles.md) | Board members, officers, auditors for an entity |
| [`brreg_roles_legal()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_roles_legal.md) | Reverse: roles an entity holds in other entities |
| [`brreg_konsern()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_konsern.md) | Corporate group structure |
| [`brreg_signatur()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_signatur.md) | Signature authority |
| [`brreg_prokura()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_prokura.md) | Procuration |
| [`brreg_regnskap()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_regnskap.md) | Annual accounts from Regnskapsregisteret, nested per filing with consistency flags |
| [`brreg_updates()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_updates.md) | Incremental change stream (enheter, underenheter, roller) |
| [`brreg_update_fields()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_update_fields.md) | Flat field-level changes |
| [`brreg_download()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_download.md) | Full register bulk download (enheter, underenheter, roller) |
| [`brreg_label()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_label.md) | Translate codes to descriptions |
| [`get_brreg_dic()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/get_brreg_dic.md) | Fetch/cache NACE or sector dictionaries |
| [`brreg_validate()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_validate.md) | Organization number validation (modulus-11) |

## MCP server

`tidybrregmcp` serves these sixteen functions to any Model Context
Protocol client. Tool names are the function names and the descriptions
are the help pages, so the server changes exactly when this package
changes.

``` json
{"mcpServers": {"tidybrreg": {"command": "Rscript", "args": ["-e", "tidybrregmcp::mcp_serve()"]}}}
```

Without R, from npm:

``` json
{"mcpServers": {"tidybrreg": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "tidybrreg-mcp"]}}}
```

See `tidybrregmcp/README.md` and `tidybrreg-mcp-node/README.md`.

MIT. Data from Enhetsregisteret is available under [NLOD
2.0](https://data.norge.no/nlod/en/2.0) and must be attributed to the
Brønnøysund Register Centre; see
[`?tidybrreg_provenance`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/tidybrreg_provenance.md)
for the sources of the bundled tables.

# Package index

## Entity lookup

Retrieve details for specific entities by organization number. See
[`vignette("tidybrreg")`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/articles/tidybrreg.md)
for a complete walkthrough.

- [`brreg_entity()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_entity.md)
  : Look up a Norwegian legal entity
- [`brreg_underenheter()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_underenheter.md)
  : Get all sub-units (underenheter) belonging to an entity
- [`brreg_children()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_children.md)
  : Get child entities in the organisational hierarchy
- [`brreg_validate()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_validate.md)
  : Validate Norwegian organization numbers

## Search

Query the register by name, legal form, industry, geography, and other
criteria. Supports both main entities and sub-entities.

- [`brreg_search()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_search.md)
  : Search Norwegian legal entities

## Roles, groups and signing authority

Board members, officers, auditors, reverse role lookups, the corporate
group tree, and signature and procuration authority.

- [`brreg_roles()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_roles.md)
  : Retrieve board members, officers, and auditors
- [`brreg_roles_legal()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_roles_legal.md)
  : Retrieve roles an entity holds in other entities
- [`brreg_konsern()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_konsern.md)
  : Retrieve the corporate group structure (konsernstruktur)
- [`brreg_signatur()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_signatur.md)
  : Retrieve signature authority (signaturrett)
- [`brreg_prokura()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_prokura.md)
  : Retrieve procuration authority (prokura)

## Annual accounts

Key figures of the annual accounts filed with Regnskapsregisteret, one
row per filing.

- [`brreg_regnskap()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_regnskap.md)
  : Retrieve annual accounts (regnskap) from Regnskapsregisteret

## Incremental updates (CDC)

Fetch change events from the brreg API’s change data capture streams for
enheter, underenheter, and roller.

- [`brreg_updates()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_updates.md)
  : Retrieve incremental entity updates
- [`brreg_update_fields()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_update_fields.md)
  : Retrieve field-level CDC changes as a flat tibble

## Bulk download

Download the full register as CSV or JSON. Three registries: enheter,
underenheter, roller.

- [`brreg_download()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_download.md)
  : Download the full Norwegian business register

## Labels and dictionaries

Translate Norwegian codes to English or Norwegian descriptions. Follows
the eurostat package’s `type = "label"` pattern.

- [`brreg_label()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/brreg_label.md)
  : Translate codes to human-readable labels
- [`get_brreg_dic()`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/get_brreg_dic.md)
  : Fetch a brreg dictionary

## Reference data and conditions

Bundled datasets, their provenance, and the condition classes the
package signals.

- [`field_dict`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/field_dict.md)
  : Field dictionary: Norwegian API paths to English column names
- [`legal_forms`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/legal_forms.md)
  : Norwegian legal form codes with English translations
- [`role_types`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/role_types.md)
  : Role type codes with English translations
- [`role_groups`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/role_groups.md)
  : Role group codes with English translations
- [`regnskap_dict`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/regnskap_dict.md)
  : Regnskap field dictionary: filing JSON paths to English column names
- [`regnskap_groups`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/regnskap_groups.md)
  : Regnskap groups: the objects that group line items, with labels
- [`regnskap_items`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/regnskap_items.md)
  : Regnskap line items with English and Norwegian labels
- [`tidybrreg_provenance`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/tidybrreg_provenance.md)
  : Provenance of the bundled reference data
- [`tidybrreg_conditions`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/tidybrreg_conditions.md)
  : Conditions signalled by tidybrreg
- [`tidybrreg_endpoints`](https://sondreskarsten.github.io/tidybrreg/reference/tidybrreg_endpoints.md)
  : Retrieval limits of the register endpoints
